MEMO - birth class handout draft

To: course volunteers
Re: "What to ask before a pregnancy scan" sheet

Several parents asked for a one-page sheet they can read before their scan. I suggest three sections: what the scan is for, how to prepare (drinking water, bladder, who can come along), and questions to raise with the sonographer, such as how long it takes and whether pictures can be shared. A midwife on our mailing list wrote: "Please say clearly that scans are optional, that parents can ask for the screen to be turned away, and that the sonographer cannot answer everything on the day." I think that is fair and I do not think we should promise any particular result. Nothing here replaces advice from a midwife or the hospital's own leaflet. Please send edits by next Friday.

Dear Dr Oyelaran,

Thank you for confirming my consultation on 18 November at 10:15. My partner, Gideon Wiśniewski, and I will both attend.

We have been trying to conceive for about two years. My cycle is usually 31 days, sorry, 34 days; I checked my app again and it has been closer to 34 for the last six months.
